assumptions: notes.txt is meant to hold a single short line, so the edit stays on that one line
The edit must not remove existing content, only extend it

decisions.choice: Appended ", updated" to the existing single line in notes.txt, leaving the original text intact.
decisions.whyItMatters: It keeps the note truthful about its state while preserving the original content, so anyone reading notes.txt still sees the prior statement plus the fact that it was revised.

alternatives.option: Replace the line entirely with new wording
alternatives.consequence: Would lose the original note content, making it impossible to see what the file previously said.
Would avoid any risk but fail the goal of making a small edit, leaving the note not reflecting the update.

recommendation.choice: Append ", updated" to the existing line
recommendation.reason: It is the smallest safe change that records the update without destroying existing information.
